limits.source: YouTube Help — Partner Program overview & eligibility
limits.value: 1,000 subscribers plus 4,000 qualified watch hours in 12 months, or 10 million qualified Shorts views in 90 days. Announced changes raise these from 1 Feb 2027 — verify before relying.
10,000 units/day default per project. A video upload (videos.insert) costs 1,600 units — about 6 uploads a day. Search costs 100 units.
Videos uploaded through unverified API projects are locked to private viewing. Wayne.clips drafts default to private for the same reason.
Posting through the API needs an approved developer app. Until one exists, Wayne.clips offers post-by-hand export (video + caption) only.
Publishing through the API needs an approved app with content-publishing permission. Until one exists, Wayne.clips offers post-by-hand export only.
Captions 120 characters or fewer, plain words, 3 hashtags by default (up to 5 on YouTube, 8 on Instagram). Sponsored clips start with "Ad:".

note: Platform limits, quotas and monetisation thresholds change often. Nothing here is a fact — each entry carries its source and the date it was last checked. Edit in Settings; the UI always shows 'last checked'.
